VM - Context Names.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Manages Variable Context names. This VI can be used to assign or reassign a name to a context, retrieve the name assigned to a context, or locate the context handle associated with a given name.

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies a handle of opened local context if you need either assign or obtain a name of the context. Pass -1 if you need obtain a name of the global context.
VC Name defines a name is to be assigned to the context. A context name may consist of any printable characters including a space mark ('\s') providing that the first character is not a space mark. VarMan doesn't allow names to include characters with codes less than 32. If you assign a name to a context, the name must be unique. The VI returns an error if you try to assign invalid name to a context or there is a context that has the same name.
In addition, this parameter is used to find a context handle if its name is known.
action specifies an operation that is to be executed:

0nothingdoes nothing.
1resetcancels all name assignments.
2assign nameassigns VC Name to the context specified by VC Handle.
3get namereturns a name assigned to the context specified by VC Handle.
4get handlereturns a a handle of the context that has given VC Name.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
VC Handle out. If action is get handle, it returns handle of the variable context with name equal to VC Name (if no one context has the given name, the VI returns an error). For other values of action, VC Handle out duplicates VC Handle.
VC Name out. If action is get name, it returns a name previously assigned to the context specified by VC Handle (VI returns an error if there is no name assigned to the context). For other values of action, VC Name out duplicates VC Name.
error code returns a value identifying an error:

0no errorsuccessfully completed.
1wrong namename contains characters with codes less than 32 or the first character is a space mark.
2name not foundthere is no a context that has the specified name.
3non-unique namean attempt to assign the name that is already assigned to another context.
4invalid handlethe specified handle doesn't refer to any context.
5unknown error
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
